title: Rare-book-stripping monks above a strip club
summary: Peter Levenda tells of Rare-book-stripping monks above a strip club, about early 1970s at Jamaica, Queens, New York, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: went to visit them at their location which was they had a chapel and it was located above a strip club in Jamaica, Queens.

plain: Peter Levenda, an author who writes about the occult and secret history, says that in the early 1970s he visited a group of monks in Jamaica, Queens, in New York City. He says their chapel sat above a strip club, and that these monks were involved in stripping and taking rare books. He tells it as one of the odd underground worlds he moved through as a young man.
